nodes.name: Final Watch
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: Dawn ends Mira's final watch. If the signal is real, she has one hour.

nodes.name: Black Water
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: The sea is too still. Even the antenna seems to hold its breath.

nodes.name: Three Notes
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: Then the radio taps three notes, soft as a finger on glass.

nodes.name: Tuned Signal
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: She slows the dial. The tones become words: BELOW THE LIGHT.

nodes.name: Brass Key
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: The locker sighs open. A brass key swings from red thread.

nodes.name: Lune Listens
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: Mira waits for Lune to hear it too. The third note changes pitch.

nodes.name: Quiet Deck
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: For one long minute, the deck answers only with cold wind.

nodes.name: Signal Confirmed
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: The repeat is clearer: the lighthouse is calling from below the beam.

nodes.name: Key Confirmed
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: The red-thread key warms in Lune's palm, pointing toward the hatch.

nodes.name: Lune Confirms
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: Lune hums the third note back. The receiver steadies under her hand.

nodes.name: Last Signal
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: Mira catches the missing phrase: ANSWER TOGETHER BEFORE DAWN.

nodes.name: Last Key
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: The key's teeth match the brass mark stamped beside the receiver.

nodes.name: Last Trust
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: Lune hears the pause between notes. It is waiting for two voices.

nodes.name: Below The Light
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: The antenna points to the lighthouse. Something there is answering us.

nodes.name: Signal And Key
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: Signal and key point below the lighthouse room.

nodes.name: All Three Clues
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: Signal, key, and Lune's rhythm say: answer together.

nodes.name: Together Answer
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: They answer at once. The lighthouse opens, not upward, but inward.

nodes.name: Signal And Lune
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: Lune matches the signal's rhythm. The reply is meant for both of them.

nodes.name: Under The Deck
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: Below the deck, a warm lamp blinks in a room nobody mapped.

nodes.name: Key And Lune
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: The key warms when Lune hums. Whatever waits below is listening.

nodes.name: A Shared Clue
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: That pitch means reply, not warning. Someone wants us to answer.

nodes.name: Beacon Answer
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: The lens answers before Mira speaks: three blue flashes, then one gold.

nodes.name: Room Wakes
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: The key turns. A hidden room below the deck wakes with gold light.

nodes.name: Lune Reply
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: Lune sends three taps. The receiver clicks back, careful and close.

nodes.name: Sunrise Wait
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: Mira lowers the receiver. Dawn spills across the rail, and one gull calls.

nodes.name: Ending: Signal
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: At dawn, the lighthouse lens flashes their names in patient blue.

nodes.name: Coda: Signal
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: Mira pockets the last flash. Somewhere below, a door unlocks.

nodes.name: Ending: Together
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: Inside the light, their two names become a map home.

nodes.name: Coda: Together
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: By sunrise, the ship has a new course and the sea remembers them.

nodes.name: Ending: Hatch
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: Under the hatch waits a humming room, bright as a held breath.

nodes.name: Coda: Hatch
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: Lune steps in first. The machine writes tomorrow across the wall.

nodes.name: Ending: Reply
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: Lune taps back once. Far away, the sea answers with a light.

nodes.name: Coda: Reply
nodes.speaker: Lune
nodes.dialogue: The answer repeats their names, softer each time, until dawn keeps it.

nodes.name: Ending: Sunrise
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: They wait. The first gull cries, and the mystery saves one secret.

nodes.name: Coda: Sunrise
nodes.speaker: Mira
nodes.dialogue: They leave the radio on. By noon, it will be quiet enough to miss.
